Multiply a fraction by a whole number

Write a whole number as a fraction, cancel common factors first, then multiply the tops. Each product is two factors only — ⅓×15, then ⅓×4, then ⅓×22. Example 2: &frac27; with a negative whole, then &frac27;×⅜ simplified to &frac{3}{28}.
